title: Ron Johnson sees his lost dog's fate in a crystal
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Ron Johnson sees his lost dog's fate in a crystal, about 1972 at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: Grant Cameron, a UFO researcher, tells a story about a man named Ron Johnson whose dog went missing around 1972 and who never knew what happened to it. Cameron says that, years later, Johnson watched the dog's life play out in a crystal and saw a neighbor come by, shoot the dog, throw it in the back of a pickup and dump it at the town dump. In his telling, the crystal could show real past events.
